title: Oversell: the expiry sweep zeroes a lot the goods receipt had just released
notes: The goods receipt reads stocks:4471 at +0ms, spends 260ms in the supplier API and commits available=53 at +260ms. The expiry sweep read the same lot at +200ms -- still QUARANTINED, still the 3 units it counted -- and commits available=0 at +340ms, so its stale view wins. The reservation at +600ms is correct code refusing to sell units the row says do not exist.
assertions: assert final != int(CORRUPT_VALUE), f'lost update still wins: {final} must not be {CORRUPT_VALUE}'
assert final >= 1, f'the received units were written off: {final} sellable left'
assert int(field(db, 'stocks', PRIMARY_KEY, 'receipt_applications', 0)) <= 1, 'the goods receipt was applied twice'
assert field(db, 'stocks', PRIMARY_KEY, 'status') in ('AVAILABLE', 'SOLD_OUT'), 'the lot was never released for sale'
duplicate_assertions: assert applied == 1, f'goods receipt applied {applied} times for a single event id'
assert available == 53, f'a retried receipt double-counted the delivery: {available} units'
